deck.title: QueerCade — find your next queer game

props.title:
QueerCade
Find your next ==queer game==.
props.subtitle: A curated vault where LGBTQ+ games are easy to find, easy to love, and impossible to miss.

slides.notes: Welcome! QueerCade is a discovery platform for LGBTQ+ games. Open with the core promise: players who want queer games shouldn't have to dig through storefront tags to find them. All materials live in the open on GitHub.

left.label: Today
left.title: Scattered and easy to miss
points: LGBTQ+ titles spread across many storefronts and inconsistent tags
Discovery depends on luck — a search, a streamer, a retweet
Small releases with no marketing vanish in days
The players who would love them never hear about them

right.label: With QueerCade
right.title: One curated home
points: A single, searchable vault dedicated to queer games
Hidden gems surface through public appreciations
Players find their next favorite, and show it some love

slides.notes: The problem isn't that queer games don't exist — they're everywhere. The problem is they're scattered across storefronts and inconsistent tags, so the players who would love them most miss them entirely. This is a discovery failure, not a supply failure.

props.title: A curated vault, ==one tap of love.==

tiles.title: Curated collection
tiles.body: A hand-picked vault of LGBTQ+ games, browsable in one place

tiles.title: Game pages
tiles.body: Every game gets a page with cover art, description, and links out to the storefronts

tiles.title: Pixel-heart appreciation
tiles.body: Show a game some love with a one-tap appreciation — counted publicly

slides.notes: Three simple verbs: browse, open, love. The pixel heart is the signature interaction — one tap to appreciate a game, done in public so the love is visible to everyone.

items.title: Browse the vault
items.body: Curated entries with covers and short descriptions — the whole collection at a glance

items.title: Open a game page
items.body: Read about the game, see who's loved it, follow links out to the storefronts

items.title: Tap the pixel heart
items.body: One tap of appreciation, counted publicly so hidden gems visibly rise

slides.notes: The loop is deliberately simple: browse curated entries, open a game page, tap the pixel heart. Appreciations are counted publicly — that's the mechanism that makes hidden gems rise.

props.caption: is all it takes to push a hidden gem up the vault, in full view of the whole community

slides.notes: The magic is the public count. One tap feels trivial, but the aggregate signal — visible to everyone — is what lifts small games out of obscurity.

props.label: Community-first
props.title: Built by and for the ==LGBTQ+ gaming community.==
props.body: New games enter the vault through a recurring scan for fresh releases, so the collection stays alive and grows with the community.

slides.notes: QueerCade isn't a storefront with a pride banner once a year — it's built by and for the community, and a recurring scan keeps feeding fresh releases into the vault automatically.
